data.name: Khairiya
data.gender_notes: Khairiya is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic word 'khair', which means 'good' and 'generous'. The name Khairiya carries the meaning “Bountiful, Generous” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Hindi. Parents who choose Khairiya usually hope their child will grow to embody bountiful, generous and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A spiritual name that symbolizes abundance and kindness.
data.etymology: Khairiya belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Bountiful, Generous.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Khairiya total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_arabic.name: خيرية
in_arabic.meaning: خيرية تعني الخير الكثير والجود والكرم
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم خيرية مشتق من الجذر العربي 'خ-ي-ر' والذي يعني الخير والجود والكرم، ورد في القرآن الكريم في عدة آيات، منها قول الله تعالى: 'وَيُؤْذُونَ النَّبِيَّ وَيَقُولُونَ هُوَ أُذُنٌ قُلْ أُذُنُ خَيْرٍ لَّكُمْ'، يرمز الاسم إلى الشخصية المعطاءة والمحبة للخير

in_urdu.name: خیریا
in_urdu.meaning: خیریا کا مطلب ہے بہت سا خیر اور خوبی
in_urdu.long_meaning: خیریا نام عربی جڑ 'خ-ي-ر' سے ماخوذ ہے جس کا مطلب ہے خیر، خوبی اور سخاوت، یہ نام جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں میں مقبول ہے، خاص طور پر ہندوستان اور پاکستان میں، جہاں یہ خیر اور برکت کی علامت کے طور پر دیکھا جاتا ہے

in_hindi.name: खैरिया
in_hindi.meaning: खैरिया का अर्थ है बहुत सारा अच्छा और अच्छाई
in_hindi.long_meaning: खैरिया नाम अरबी मूल 'ख-ई-र' से लिया गया है जिसका अर्थ है अच्छा, अच्छाई और उदारता, यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में लोकप्रिय है, जहां यह शुभ और सकारात्मक अर्थों के साथ जुड़ा हुआ है

in_english.name: Khairiya
in_english.meaning: Khairiya means abundance of good, kindness, and generosity
in_english.long_meaning: The name Khairiya is derived from the Arabic root 'خ-ي-ر' (kh-y-r), which signifies good, kindness, and generosity. This root appears in several Quranic verses, emphasizing its importance in Islamic tradition. The name symbolizes a person known for their benevolence, love for good, and charitable nature. Across various Muslim cultures, Khairiya is cherished for its positive connotations and spiritual significance.
